passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Priya Raman <priya.raman@mailnest.example>
From: Customer Care, Skyline Pacific Airways
Date: June 14
Subject: Change to your flight SP 218

Dear Ms. Raman,

We regret to inform you that flight SP 218 from Auckland to Singapore on June 21 has been rescheduled because the aircraft is arriving late from its previous trip. The new departure time is 11:45 P.M. instead of 8:15 P.M., and you will land in Singapore at 5:30 A.M. on June 22.

Because of this change, we can no longer guarantee your connection to Bangkok on SP 640. We have therefore reserved a seat for you on SP 644, which leaves Singapore at 9:10 A.M. on June 22. Daniel Okafor
Customer Care, Skyline Pacific Airways

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To confirm a seat upgrade
To request payment for a booking
To inform a passenger of a revised departure time
To announce a new route
questions.explain: Email mở đầu bằng việc báo chuyến SP 218 "has been rescheduled" với giờ khởi hành mới 11:45 P.M., nên mục đích là thông báo giờ bay thay đổi.

questions.q: What is Ms. Raman NOT offered?
options: A full refund
A seat on a later connecting flight
A meal voucher
A complimentary hotel room
questions.explain: Email nhắc tới hoàn tiền toàn bộ, ghế trên chuyến SP 644 và phiếu ăn 25 đô la; hoàn toàn không có phòng khách sạn miễn phí.

passages.title: Notice
passages.text:
NOTICE OF TEMPORARY WATER SERVICE INTERRUPTION
Riverbend Municipal Water Authority
Date of notice: September 3

Residents of Elm Terrace, Cobbler Lane, and the Hartley Heights apartment complex will have no water on Wednesday, September 11, from 9:00 A.M. to approximately 3:00 P.M. The interruption is necessary so that crews can replace an aging main pipe under Elm Terrace.

When service is restored, the water may look cloudy or slightly discolored for a short time. This is harmless; however, we suggest running your cold tap for several minutes until the water runs clear. Residents who depend on medical equipment that requires running water should call our priority line at 555-0143 no later than September 9 so that an emergency supply can be arranged.

We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the reliability of our network.

questions.q: What are residents advised to do after water service returns?
options: Let the cold water run until it becomes clear
Boil all water before drinking it
Call the Authority to report cloudy water
Replace their household water filters
questions.explain: Thông báo khuyên "running your cold tap for several minutes until the water runs clear" sau khi có nước lại.

questions.q: Who is asked to call the priority line by September 9?
options: Anyone living on Cobbler Lane
Owners of the Hartley Heights complex
Residents who use medical equipment that needs water
Customers who want a bill adjustment
questions.explain: Chỉ những cư dân phụ thuộc vào thiết bị y tế cần nước chạy ("depend on medical equipment") mới được yêu cầu gọi đường dây ưu tiên trước ngày 9/9.

passages.title: Article
passages.text:
Green Valley Farm Expands Its Home-Delivery Program

GREEN VALLEY (April 9) - Green Valley Farm announced on Monday that it will double the number of households served by its weekly produce-box program, from 400 to 800, by the end of the summer. The farm, which grows vegetables without synthetic pesticides, started the program six years ago with just 35 customers.

"We were overwhelmed by the demand," said owner Marisol Ibarra. "Our waiting list had grown to more than 300 names, and some people had been waiting for over a year." To meet the demand, the farm has leased an additional 20 acres from a neighboring orchard and hired eight seasonal workers. It has also bought two refrigerated vans, which will allow deliveries to reach towns up to 80 kilometers away.

Customers can choose between a small box, suitable for one or two people, and a family-size box. Both contain whatever is in season, along with a newsletter of recipes. Ms. Ibarra said she hopes to add eggs and honey next year, pending approval from the regional health department. Sign-ups for the new places will open on May 1 on the farm's Web site.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: The retirement of a farm owner
The opening of a new restaurant
A plan to serve more households
A change in farming methods
questions.explain: Bài báo mở đầu bằng việc farm sẽ "double the number of households served" từ 400 lên 800, tức mở rộng để phục vụ thêm khách hàng.

questions.q: The word "overwhelmed" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
options: swamped
confused
disappointed
defeated
questions.explain: "Overwhelmed by the demand" nghĩa là nhu cầu quá lớn, bị "ngập" yêu cầu; danh sách chờ hơn 300 người cũng cho thấy điều này, nên đồng nghĩa với swamped.

questions.q: What does Ms. Ibarra hope to do next year?
options: Open a second farm 80 kilometers away
Sell eggs and honey
Start a newsletter with recipes
Reduce the price of the boxes
questions.explain: Bà nói hy vọng "to add eggs and honey next year" nếu được sở y tế chấp thuận. Bản tin công thức nấu ăn thì đã có sẵn trong hộp rồi.

passages.title: Memo
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All Staff
From: Lena Fischer, Director of Human Resources
Date: January 8
Re: Updated remote-work policy

Beginning March 1, eligible employees may work from home up to two days per week. To be eligible, an employee must have completed at least six months of service and received a satisfactory rating in his or her most recent performance review. Employees should submit a Remote Work Request form to their supervisor at least two weeks before they wish to begin. Supervisors will respond within five business days.

Remote work days must be fixed and approved in advance, and they may be changed only once a month. Employees working from home are expected to be available by phone and e-mail during core hours, 10:00 A.M. to 4:00 P.M. The company will provide a laptop and necessary equipment, but home internet costs will not be reimbursed.

Staff in the customer service and warehouse departments are not eligible because their duties require them to be on site. Information sessions will be held at noon on January 22 and January 29 in Conference Room B.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce changes in office locations
To explain new rules for working from home
To invite employees to a training course
To report the results of performance reviews
questions.explain: Memo có tiêu đề "Updated remote-work policy" và giải thích điều kiện, thủ tục làm việc tại nhà từ ngày 1/3.

questions.q: Which employee is most likely eligible for remote work?
options: A warehouse worker with two years of service
A marketing assistant hired four months ago
An accountant who joined eight months ago and has a satisfactory review
A customer service agent with a satisfactory rating
questions.explain: Cần ít nhất 6 tháng làm việc và đánh giá đạt; kế toán vào làm 8 tháng nên đủ điều kiện. Nhân viên kho và chăm sóc khách hàng bị loại, người mới 4 tháng chưa đủ thời gian.

questions.q: What will employees working from home have to pay for themselves?
options: A company laptop
Additional office equipment
A fee for submitting a request
Their home internet service
questions.explain: Memo nói công ty cấp laptop và thiết bị nhưng "home internet costs will not be reimbursed" nên nhân viên tự trả tiền internet.

passages.title: Text-message chain
passages.text:
Hana Ito (Managing Editor) [2:02 P.M.]
Quick update: the printing plant has moved our press time up. We now need all pages finalized by 8:45 tonight instead of 9:30.

Victor Alvarez (Sports) [2:04 P.M.]
Fine by me. My pages are nearly done. I'm only waiting on a photo from the swim meet.

Chloe Baptiste (Photo Desk) [2:06 P.M.]
I can send it by four. Our photographer got stuck in traffic on the way back from the stadium.

Hana Ito [2:07 P.M.]
Thanks, Chloe. Dmitri, what about the front page?

Dmitri Kowalski (News) [2:10 P.M.]
Still undecided. The city council vote may run late, and I'd hate to miss it.

Hana Ito [2:11 P.M.]
Let's hold the top half of the page until 8:00 and decide then. If the vote isn't in by then, we run the transport-strike story instead.

Dmitri Kowalski [2:12 P.M.]
Works for me. I'll have both versions ready.

Victor Alvarez [2:13 P.M.]
I can stay late and help proofread if needed.

questions.q: Why did Ms. Ito send the message?
options: To cancel the evening edition
To ask for volunteers to work overtime
To introduce a new printing plant
To announce an earlier deadline
questions.explain: Ms. Ito báo nhà in đã dời giờ in sớm lên và tất cả trang phải xong lúc 8:45 thay vì 9:30, tức là hạn chót sớm hơn.

questions.q: Why is Mr. Kowalski unsure about the front page?
options: A photograph has not arrived
A city council vote might not finish in time
The printing plant has changed its address
A story must be shortened
questions.explain: Ông viết "The city council vote may run late, and I'd hate to miss it" nên chưa quyết định nội dung trang nhất. Ảnh chờ là của trang thể thao do Mr. Alvarez phụ trách.

questions.q: At 2:12 P.M., what does Mr. Kowalski mean when he writes, "Works for me"?
options: He accepts Ms. Ito's suggestion
He is willing to work extra hours
He has finished his assigned pages
He thinks the vote should be covered later
questions.explain: Ngay trước đó Ms. Ito đề xuất giữ nửa trên trang nhất đến 8:00 rồi quyết định; "Works for me" nghĩa là ông đồng ý với đề xuất ấy.

passages.title: Customer review
passages.text:
Bluewing Air - Reviewed by Tomas Eriksen
Flight BW 305, Oslo to Lisbon - August 29
Rating: 3 out of 5 stars - "Great crew, poor communication"

I travel for business about twice a month, and I chose Bluewing Air for this trip because its fare was significantly lower than the competition. Check-in was smooth, and the online boarding pass worked perfectly. However, our departure was delayed by nearly two hours, and the only explanation we received was a brief announcement that the aircraft was "awaiting a technical inspection." No one at the gate offered water or snacks, even though many of us had waited well over an hour.

Once we were in the air, the cabin crew did an excellent job. They were courteous, and the flight attendant in my row, Ms. Teixeira, went out of her way to find me a seat with extra legroom after I mentioned my bad knee. The meal was ordinary, but the coffee was surprisingly good.

On arrival, my suitcase was among the first off the belt, which I greatly appreciated because I had a meeting to attend. Overall, I would fly Bluewing again only if the airline improves how it communicates with passengers during delays.

questions.q: Why did Mr. Eriksen select Bluewing Air?
options: It offered the earliest departure
He had collected free travel miles
Its ticket price was lower than those of other airlines
A colleague recommended it
questions.explain: Ông viết đã chọn hãng vì "its fare was significantly lower than the competition".

questions.q: What was Mr. Eriksen's main complaint?
options: Check-in took too long
The cabin crew was impolite
His luggage arrived late
He was given little information during a delay
questions.explain: Ông chỉ nhận được một thông báo ngắn về lý do trễ chuyến và không ai phát nước hay đồ ăn nhẹ; nhận xét cuối cũng nói hãng cần cải thiện việc thông tin cho hành khách.

questions.q: The phrase "went out of her way" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
options: lost her direction
made a special effort
took a long break
changed her work schedule
questions.explain: "Go out of one's way" là nỗ lực hơn mức bình thường để giúp ai; ở đây cô tiếp viên tìm cho ông chỗ rộng chân, nên gần nghĩa với "made a special effort".

questions.q: Why was Mr. Eriksen most likely pleased to get his suitcase quickly?
options: He had to attend a meeting
He needed to catch a connecting flight
His knee was hurting
He wanted to file a complaint
questions.explain: Ông nói hành lý ra sớm là điều ông rất cảm kích "because I had a meeting to attend" nên ông cần đi họp ngay.

passages.title: Job advertisement
passages.text:
SEABREEZE BEACH RESORT - NOW HIRING
Guest Relations Manager

Seabreeze Beach Resort, a 120-room property on Tamarind Bay, is looking for a Guest Relations Manager to join our team beginning September 1.

Responsibilities: supervise a team of eight front-desk and concierge employees; handle guest complaints; coordinate with the housekeeping and restaurant departments; prepare monthly satisfaction reports.

Requirements: at least four years of experience in hospitality, including two in a supervisory role; fluency in English and one other language (Mandarin or Korean preferred); strong computer skills.

Benefits: competitive salary, free meals while on duty, 20 days of paid vacation, and discounted stays at our sister resorts.

To apply, send a resume and cover letter to Ms. Gloria Santos, Human Resources, at careers@seabreeze.example by July 15. Interviews will take place during the week of July 22. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

passages.text:

Dealing with guest complaints

questions.explain: Quảng cáo liệt kê trách nhiệm "handle guest complaints"; các việc còn lại không nằm trong danh sách.

questions.q: What is NOT listed as a benefit of the job?

Paid vacation
Reduced rates at sister resorts
Housing near the resort

questions.q: What can be inferred about Mr. Park?

He has previously worked at Seabreeze

He lives near the resort
questions.explain: Quảng cáo yêu cầu ít nhất 4 năm kinh nghiệm, trong đó 2 năm giám sát; Mr. Park có 5 năm, gồm 3 năm làm quản lý, nên vượt mức tối thiểu. Ông mới chỉ học tiếng Quan Thoại 2 năm.

He could not attach his resume

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Park's application?
options: It was sent to the wrong department
It lacked a cover letter
It was received after July 15
It was submitted before the deadline
questions.explain: Hạn nộp hồ sơ là 15/7 theo quảng cáo, còn Mr. Park gửi email ngày 12/7 nên nộp đúng hạn.

passages.title: Web page
passages.text:
CIRCUIT CORNER - Returns and Exchanges

Standard returns: Most items may be returned within 30 days of purchase with the original receipt, as long as they are unopened or in like-new condition.

Opened computers, tablets, and cameras: These may be returned within 14 days of purchase and are subject to a 15 percent restocking fee unless the product is defective.

Headphones and earbuds: For hygiene reasons, these cannot be returned once opened unless they are defective.

Defective items: Defective products may be exchanged for the same model within 90 days of purchase. If the model is no longer in stock, a refund will be issued. Refunds are returned to the original form of payment within 7 to 10 business days.

Online orders: Customers who bought online can print a free prepaid return label from the My Account page. No label is needed for returns made in our stores.

She is returning it within 14 days of purchase
The tablet is defective
questions.explain: Trang web nêu phí 15% áp dụng cho thiết bị đã mở "unless the product is defective"; tablet của bà bị lỗi màn hình. Bà mua ngày 3/5 và liên hệ ngày 20/5, quá 14 ngày.

questions.q: How can Ms. Nunes return the tablet without paying for shipping?
options: By printing a label from her online account
By mailing it with a copy of her receipt
By asking support to arrange a pickup
By exchanging it at a partner shop
questions.explain: Bà mua trực tuyến, và trang web nói khách mua online có thể in nhãn trả hàng trả trước miễn phí từ trang My Account.

questions.q: What does Ms. Nunes ask that is NOT addressed on the Web page?
options: Whether a fee applies to a faulty product
Whether a replacement is possible
Whether an e-mailed receipt is accepted
Whether she can get a refund
questions.explain: Trang web có nói về phí với hàng lỗi, đổi cùng mẫu và hoàn tiền nếu hết hàng; nhưng chỉ đề cập "original receipt" mà không nói biên lai điện tử có được chấp nhận không.

passages.title: Booking confirmation
passages.text:

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Hiroshi Tanaka <h.tanaka@mailnest.example>
From: Nordair Airlines Customer Service
Date: March 8
Subject: Cancellation of flight NA 482 on March 12

Dear Mr. Tanaka,

We regret to inform you that flight NA 482 from Helsinki to Edinburgh on March 12 has been canceled because of a crew shortage. We have automatically rebooked you on NA 486, which departs Helsinki at 8:20 P.M. and arrives in Edinburgh at 9:50 P.M. A 15-euro meal voucher will be available at the Nordair service desk in Helsinki.

If you would prefer to travel on a different day, you may change your booking free of charge through the Manage Booking page on our Web site.

Because you were notified fewer than 14 days before departure, you may be entitled to compensation under passenger-rights regulations. To make a claim, please complete the form at nordair.example/claim within 30 days of your original travel date.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Nordair Airlines Customer Service

passages.title: Online chat
passages.text:
Hiroshi Tanaka [March 11, 6:40 P.M.]
Hello. I received notice that my March 12 flight to Edinburgh was canceled. The new flight gets me in more than four hours late. Is there any way to arrive earlier?

Olivia, Nordair Support [6:43 P.M.]
I'm sorry for the trouble, Mr. Tanaka. Let me check. The only other option that day is a flight through Amsterdam on a partner airline, arriving in Edinburgh at 7:30 P.M. I can book it if you like.

Hiroshi Tanaka [6:44 P.M.]
Yes, please. Will my checked bag be transferred?

Olivia, Nordair Support [6:47 P.M.]
Yes, your bag will go through to Edinburgh. The new booking is confirmed, and you'll receive a new e-mail shortly.

Hiroshi Tanaka [6:48 P.M.]
Thanks. And I should still use the claim form?

Olivia, Nordair Support [6:49 P.M.]
Yes. You have until April 11 to submit it.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To confirm an online check-in
To tell a passenger that a flight was canceled and he has been rebooked
To offer an upgrade to business class
To request payment for extra baggage
questions.explain: Email báo chuyến NA 482 "has been canceled" và hãng đã tự động chuyển ông sang chuyến NA 486.

questions.q: What is indicated about Mr. Tanaka's ticket?
options: It includes two checked bags
It is a one-way fare
It can be changed at no cost before departure
It was bought through a travel agency
questions.explain: Giấy xác nhận ghi vé Economy Flex "can be changed free of charge up to 24 hours before departure". Vé có 1 hành lý ký gửi và có cả chiều về.

questions.q: When will Mr. Tanaka most likely arrive in Edinburgh on March 12?
options: At 5:30 P.M.
At 9:50 P.M.
At 4:00 P.M.
At 7:30 P.M.
questions.explain: Trong chat, nhân viên đề nghị chuyến qua Amsterdam đến Edinburgh lúc 7:30 P.M. và ông đồng ý ("Yes, please"), thay cho NA 486 đến lúc 9:50 P.M.

questions.q: The word "entitled" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to
options: required
eligible
pleased
named
questions.explain: "You may be entitled to compensation" nghĩa là bạn có thể đủ điều kiện để nhận bồi thường, đồng nghĩa với eligible.

questions.q: By what date must Mr. Tanaka submit his claim form?
options: April 11
March 11
March 12
April 22
questions.explain: Email yêu cầu nộp trong vòng 30 ngày kể từ ngày bay ban đầu (12/3), tức đến 11/4; nhân viên chat cũng xác nhận "until April 11".

passages.title: Web page
passages.text:
HILLCREST ORGANICS - Weekly Harvest Box

Choose the box that fits your household. All produce is certified organic and picked within 24 hours of delivery.

Small box (1-2 people) ........ $28
Medium box (3-4 people) ........ $42
Large box (5 or more people) ........ $58

Add-ons: farm eggs, $6 per dozen; wildflower honey, $9 per jar; sourdough bread, $5 per loaf.

Delivery: Thursdays, between 4:00 P.M. and 7:00 P.M. Delivery is free within 25 kilometers of the farm. For addresses beyond 25 kilometers, a fee of $5 per delivery applies.

Skipping a week: Please notify us by midnight on the Sunday before the delivery week. Boxes skipped after that time will still be charged.

Subscriptions may be paused or canceled at any time with seven days' notice.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:

Subject: Problems with my last box and a request to skip

Dear Hillcrest Organics,

I have received a medium box with a dozen eggs every week since April, and I have been very happy until now. However, the box delivered on June 13 did not include my eggs, and the lettuce arrived wilted.

Also, I will be traveling from July 1 to July 14, so please skip my deliveries during that period. I live in Millbrook, about 30 kilometers from your farm, so please make sure my account is adjusted correctly.

Jonas Berger

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:

Thank you for letting us know, and please accept our apologies. We have applied a $10 credit to your account to cover the missing eggs and the lettuce. In addition, your next box, on June 20, will include an extra dozen eggs at no charge.

We have also noted that you will be away from July 1 to July 14. Your deliveries on July 4 and July 11 have been skipped, and regular service will resume on July 18. Since your request reached us well before the deadline, there will be no charge for those weeks.

Sandra Whitfield
Customer Service, Hillcrest Organics

questions.q: Why did Mr. Berger write to Hillcrest Organics?
options: To increase the size of his box
To cancel his subscription permanently
To order honey and bread
To report problems and ask to pause deliveries
questions.explain: Ông báo thiếu trứng và rau héo trong hộp ngày 13/6, đồng thời nhờ bỏ qua các lần giao từ 1 đến 14/7.

questions.q: How much does Mr. Berger most likely pay for each regular delivery?
questions.explain: Hộp cỡ vừa 42 đô la, cộng một tá trứng 6 đô la, cộng phí giao 5 đô la vì Millbrook cách trang trại khoảng 30 km (hơn 25 km): tổng 53 đô la.

questions.q: What does Ms. Whitfield offer Mr. Berger?
options: A refund to his credit card
A $10 account credit and a free dozen eggs
A free upgrade to a large box
A permanent discount on honey
questions.explain: Thư trả lời nói đã cộng 10 đô la vào tài khoản và hộp kế tiếp sẽ có thêm một tá trứng miễn phí.

questions.q: Which deliveries will be skipped?
options: Those on July 4 and July 11
Those on July 1 and July 8
Those on June 27 and July 4
Every delivery in June
questions.explain: Giao hàng vào thứ Năm; trong khoảng 1-14/7 chỉ có hai thứ Năm là 4/7 và 11/7, và thư trả lời xác nhận hai lần giao này bị bỏ qua.

questions.q: According to the Web page, what must customers do to skip a week?
options: Pay a $5 fee
Call the farm on Thursday
Give notice by the Sunday before that week
Cancel and subscribe again later
questions.explain: Trang web ghi cần báo "by midnight on the Sunday before the delivery week", nếu không vẫn bị tính tiền.

passages.title: Article
passages.text:
Gazette to Publish Book of Readers' Memories

MAPLE RIDGE (August 5) - To celebrate its 100th anniversary, the Maple Ridge Gazette will publish a book of 60 true stories submitted by its readers. The collection, titled "A Century of Us," will be produced by Cobalt Books, a local publisher.

Readers of all ages are invited to write about a memorable moment in the town's history or in their own lives. Each story must be no longer than 1,200 words and should be submitted through the Gazette's Web site by August 31. A committee of editors and librarians will choose the final 60 entries, and the authors of selected stories will each receive five free copies of the book.

All proceeds from sales will go to the Maple Ridge Literacy Fund, which supports reading programs in local schools. The book will be launched at the public library on November 15.

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: stories@mapleridgegazette.example
From: Aaron Whitaker <a.whitaker@mailnest.example>
Date: August 28
Subject: Story submission - "The Winter the River Froze"

Dear Editors,

I have attached my story about the winter of 1963, when the Maple River froze solid and the whole town came out to skate. I have been a Gazette reader for over forty years, and this project means a great deal to me.

I should mention that my story is about 1,350 words. Is that acceptable, or must I shorten it? I would also like to include two old photographs from my family album. Is that allowed?

Thank you for organizing this wonderful project.

Aaron Whitaker

passages.title: E-mail
passages.text:
To: Aaron Whitaker <a.whitaker@mailnest.example>
From: Rachel Obi, Features Editor
Date: August 29
Subject: RE: Story submission - "The Winter the River Froze"

Dear Mr. Whitaker,

Thank you for your lovely story. Unfortunately, the 1,200-word limit is firm because of the space we have in the book, so we would ask you to trim about 150 words. Because so many readers have asked for more time, we have extended the submission deadline to September 7, so you have plenty of time to revise it.

You are welcome to send up to two photographs, as long as they are high-resolution scans and you own the rights to them. Writers will be told whether their stories were selected by September 20.

Best regards,
Rachel Obi
Features Editor, Maple Ridge Gazette

questions.q: What is the purpose of the article?
options: To review a newly published novel
To advertise jobs at the newspaper
To report on a school's reading program
To announce a book of readers' stories
questions.explain: Bài báo mở đầu rằng tờ Gazette "will publish a book of 60 true stories submitted by its readers" nhân dịp kỷ niệm 100 năm.

questions.q: What is indicated about Mr. Whitaker's story?
options: It is longer than the maximum length
It has already been selected
It was submitted after the deadline
It contains no photographs
questions.explain: Bài báo giới hạn 1.200 từ, còn truyện của Mr. Whitaker khoảng 1.350 từ nên vượt quá giới hạn. Ông gửi ngày 28/8, trước hạn 31/8.

questions.q: By what date should Mr. Whitaker send his shortened story?
options: August 31
September 7
September 20
November 15
questions.explain: Bài báo nêu hạn 31/8 nhưng Ms. Obi thông báo đã gia hạn đến 7/9; 20/9 là ngày thông báo kết quả, 15/11 là ngày ra mắt sách.

questions.q: What will Mr. Whitaker receive if his story is chosen?
options: A cash payment
A free subscription to the Gazette
A page of photographs
Five copies of the book
questions.explain: Bài báo viết tác giả của truyện được chọn "will each receive five free copies of the book".

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned about the book?
options: A local publisher will produce it
Proceeds will support a literacy fund
It will be sold in stores across the country
It will be launched at the library
questions.explain: Bài báo nêu nhà xuất bản địa phương Cobalt Books, tiền bán sách đóng góp cho quỹ xóa mù chữ và buổi ra mắt tại thư viện; không nói gì về việc bán trên toàn quốc.
